Check-In Instructions

Choose your check-in route below

Step 1
Make your way to Metropol Building 1
Head to 81 Cooyong Street, Reid. Use the remote to swipe on the reader to enter the building. The apartment is on Level 9.
Step 2
Your keys
Your keyring includes a key and a blue remote. The remote opens the car park garage and acts as your swipe card on every reader throughout the building.
Step 3
Take the lift to Level 9
At the lifts, swipe the remote on the reader inside the lift, then press Level 9. Your apartment is 904.
Step 1
Head to 81 Cooyong Street — turn left off Cooyong St
Drive along Cooyong Street and turn left into the car park entry at the intersection of Cooyong Street and Akuna Street.
Step 2
Turn left and head down the ramp
After turning left, drive straight down the ramp into the car park. Continue straight until you see another ramp, then turn right.
Step 3
Between the concrete pillars — take the right ramp
Once down the first ramp, between the two concrete pillars you'll see another half-down ramp — take a right here.
Step 4
Follow Ramp 1 down — turn right
Follow Ramp 1 down and turn right. You will come to a black garage door on the right-hand side.
Step 5
Use the remote to open the black garage door
Use the blue remote provided to open the black garage door on your right.
Step 6
Follow the second ramp down — turn right
After the garage door, follow the second ramp down and take a right turn.
Step 7
Proceed down another ramp
Continue and proceed down another ramp.
Step 8
Turn right down the final ramp
Follow the final ramp down and turn right.
Step 9
Your car space is on the left
The car space is located on the left-hand side. Park in car space 81/904.
Final Step
Take the lift to Level 9
The apartment lift is to the right of your car space. You are on Level B3. Swipe the remote on the reader inside the lift and press Level 9. Your apartment is 904.
